exposure: Marijuana use during the third trimester
outcome: Apgar scores at one and five minutes
Incidence of pharmacologic treatment of NAS
cohort: The study included 191 maternal-infant dyads where the mothers were opioid-dependent and maintained on buprenorphine during pregnancy.
finding: While most maternal and infant outcomes showed no significant association with third-trimester marijuana exposure, there was a trend towards increased need for pharmacologic treatment for neonatal abstinence syndrome and longer infant hospital stays.
mod_finding: Marijuana exposure in the third trimester was not significantly associated with the method of delivery.
